todayDescription: From meal selection to the doorstep. Everything for your selected date.
scheduleDescription: Plan deliveries and keep every order on track.
productionDescription: Meal counts, selections, and revisions in one place.
deliveryDescription: Follow each meal until it reaches your customer.
customersDescription: Packages, schedules, and history for every customer.
menusDescription: Meal choices for each delivery date and slot.
settingsDescription: Operating rules and team access for your business.
defaultAtCutoff: The published default meal will be selected automatically at cutoff.
noNextDescription: Contact your caterer to schedule your package quota.
noDeliveriesDescription: Choose another date or create a schedule from a customer profile.
overrideHint: Changes after cutoff require a reason and appear in revision history.
skipConsequence: Cancel this delivery and release its reservation. Package expiry still applies.
rescheduleConsequence: Quota stays reserved. Select a new meal if the current one is unavailable on the new date. Package validity stays the same.
addressConsequence: Only this delivery's address will change.
menuConsequence: Only this delivery's meal will change.
reverseConsequence: Restore one quota and reserve it again for this delivery. A reason is required.
name: Name
purchaseDescription: Payment takes place outside Catera. This confirmation grants quota according to the selected package.
skipExisting: Existing occurrences, including skipped deliveries, will not be recreated.
insufficientPreview: There is not enough eligible quota for the entire schedule.
missingDefault: A default meal is missing. Complete the menu before marking production ready.
productionWait: Production freezes automatically when changes close.
cutoffTime: Change cutoff on the previous day
profileHint: Your profile address becomes the default for new bookings. Existing deliveries keep their own addresses.
myPackageDescription: Your package quota and usage, with a clear history.
profileDescription: Contact details and defaults for future deliveries.
noPackageDescription: Your caterer will record your package once your purchase is confirmed.
signInDescription: Enter your invited email address. We will send you a sign-in code.
verifyDescription: Enter the one-time code sent to your email.
noWorkspace: No business access yet. Contact an owner for an invitation.
demoDescription: Explore operations and the subscriber portal with synthetic data stored on this computer.
welcomeDescription: One place to plan, prepare, and deliver meals worth looking forward to.
loadError: We could not load your data.
noRecordsHint: Add your first record to get started.
noMenuOptions: Meal choices have not been published yet. Your caterer needs to add them.
authUnavailable: Connect Supabase and email delivery to use real accounts.
invitationHint: Users sign in with an email code after the invitation is saved.
timeZoneHint: All cutoffs use the business timezone.

error.INSUFFICIENT_QUOTA: Not enough quota. Add a package or reduce the schedule.

error.CUTOFF_NOT_REACHED: The cutoff has not been reached yet.

error.INVALID_TRANSITION: This action is not allowed for the current delivery status.

error.MENU_UNAVAILABLE: That meal is not available for the selected slot.

error.DATE_UNAVAILABLE: That date or slot is unavailable.

error.INVALID_SCHEDULE: Check the date range, weekdays, and delivery slots.

error.SLOT_IN_USE: Active deliveries still use this slot.
error.DUPLICATE_DELIVERY: This customer already has a delivery on that date and slot.
